This directory contains fonts used by CI when building `GraemeBlair-CV.tex`.

Included:
- `GenBas*.ttf` (Gentium Basic) from Debian package `fonts-sil-gentium-basic`.
- License: `LICENSE-GentiumBasic.txt` (SIL Open Font License).

Not included:
- `Hoefler*` and `Monaco*` are proprietary fonts and are not redistributed in this repository.
  If you have a license to use them, add those font files to this directory.
